meta.title: PlaySlot
meta.description: Book football pitches online — fast, simple, and reliable for players and pitch owners.

language.title: Choose your language

landing.title: PlaySlot — book football pitches online
landing.subtitle: Book your slots quickly and easily. Find a pitch in your city, browse available time slots, and confirm your booking in just a few steps. Pitch owners manage their calendar, pricing, and confirmations — all in one place.

app.searchDescription: Find football venues in your city and book available time slots.

setup.description: Complete the steps below to publish your venue and start accepting bookings.

setup.workingHoursDescription: Set opening hours for each day of the week.
setup.workingHoursHint: The venue is only bookable during these hours. Times use 24-hour format (e.g. 13:00, 00:00 for midnight).
setup.confirmationPendingHint: You must approve or reject each booking.
setup.reviewDescription: Check your details before the venue goes live in search.

dashboard.calendarHint: View booked and available slots for your venue. Click a booked slot for player details.
